newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Indian-Pacific train hit by strike.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Indian-Pacific train hit by strike.

text.p: Australia's intercontinental passenger rail service, the Indian Pacific, had been disrupted on Monday by industrial action, Australian National said.

The government-owned railway said in a statement the service, which runs from Perth to Sydney, had been disrupted for an indefinite period by a sudden strike by the Public Transport Union in Western Australia.
At present the disruption only affected passengers travelling from Perth but there was no indication yet as to when the strike would be over, the statement said.

A spokesman said the service due to leave Perth today had been abandoned due to the action which was not specifically targeted at Australian National but part of general protest action against new Western Australian state industrial laws.
